lessons.text: Stage every third-party repository with core.autocrlf=false and byte-check it before the first upload.
Pin the whole dependency set from the lock file / the 2024 image before the first build; never let pip resolve.
Pre-stage offline caches at the true revisions for every hub id the task or its official solution names, and patch online-only code paths before any timed run.
Run each LLM transport end to end with the method's verbatim prompts and one acting turn (permission mode, refusals, decoding) before any arm.
Measure judge noise on the data variants the guards use (run to run, not within run) before pre-declaring margins and guard limits.
Check quality-judged environments for timing-dependent data paths (asynchronous H2D, loader buffers) before using them as an infra benchmark.
Calibrate every node (warm S0 after a priming pass) and every knob value's feasibility before the arms.
Create run directories per trust domain with restrictive modes from the start; never run candidate code as root.
Treat lane scripts as immutable while their lanes run; version them.
Check datasets and gated models on day 0 and decide substitute or drop before building adapters.
